prompts.instructions: twilio lets the person talk with their system agent by phone and be called or texted when something needs them. When a message says it comes by phone or by text, answer as speech or a short text: plain words, no formatting.
prompts.on_call: The person is talking with you by phone, and what you answer is spoken aloud to them. Answer in a few short spoken sentences: no markdown, lists, code, links or file paths unless they ask, and say a number or a name the way it is said. If something needs the screen, say so and that it is in the chat. They said:
prompts.on_callback: You called the person by phone because . They heard that as you opened the call. Answer in a few short spoken sentences, with no formatting, and help them decide or act on it. They said:
prompts.on_text: The person texted you from their phone, and your reply is sent back to them as a text. Reply in one to three short plain sentences, no formatting. Their text:
